title: PayProxy Provider: Wallet, Virtual Cards, and Safe Test Mode
audience: Cash App/Chime/prepaid users declined by cloud/hotel/rental/subscription
objectives: Understand how PayProxyProvider holds WalletBalance, VirtualCard list, and CardTransaction history
Use the usePayProxy hook to read wallet, cards, and history in any component
Practice safely in test-mode with demo data and no real money moves
Manage card lifecycle with freeze/unfreeze/close and respond to close-to-cap and low-balance warnings

designContext.lightAiryMint: Clear Mint midnight-ledger restyle only with light airy mint tokens described in words not hex, airy backgrounds and soft mint accents for a calm ledger feel
designContext.typefaces: Space Grotesk for display headings plus Figtree for body text for clear hierarchy across wallet and card info
designContext.softCards: 14px soft cards with gentle rounded corners and subtle shadow for wallet, virtual cards and transaction panels
designContext.shell: sticky AppShell that stays visible on scroll for persistent navigation and account context
designContext.bands: tinted and dark LedgerBand sections framing content plus restyled home/dashboard panels in the same Clear Mint language without hex codes or theme key names

pitch30s: Ever been declined trying to pay for cloud hosting, a hotel, or a rental car with Cash App or Chime? PayProxy gives you virtual cards backed by your wallet balance, each with its own name, cap, and end date. Learn how your balance, cards, and transaction history work together, how to freeze or close cards, and why test mode keeps your real money safe while you practice.

analogies.title: Wallet as Envelope
analogies.explanation: Your WalletBalance is like cash in one main envelope — the total you have available to distribute before you create any spending envelopes.

analogies.title: Card as Labeled Envelope
analogies.explanation: Each VirtualCard is like a labeled envelope with a name, cap, and end-date written on it — you put a spending limit and expiry on the front so it can only be used as intended.

analogies.title: History as Receipt Shoebox
analogies.explanation: CardTransaction history is like a shoebox of receipts where each slip shows store, amount, date, and result, so you can audit what was approved or declined.

concepts.title: PayProxyProvider State Container
concepts.explanation: PayProxyProvider is the central state container holding WalletBalance for available funds, a VirtualCard list where each card has name/cap/end-date, and CardTransaction history capturing store/amount/date/result for every attempt.

concepts.title: usePayProxy Hook
concepts.explanation: The usePayProxy hook exposes wallet, cards, history, and actions to any component under the provider, avoiding prop drilling for balance and card controls.

concepts.title: Test Mode Demo Data
concepts.explanation: Test-mode uses demoUser, demoBalance, demoCards, demoTransactions and testModeMessage to simulate flows with no real money moves, so learners can practice safely.

concepts.title: Per-User Isolation
concepts.explanation: Per-user isolation ensures each user only sees their own WalletBalance, VirtualCards, and CardTransactions, mirroring real account separation.

concepts.title: Freeze Unfreeze Close
concepts.explanation: Card lifecycle actions freeze/unfreeze/close let you temporarily pause a card, resume it, or permanently close it when it is no longer needed.

concepts.title: Warnings for Limits
concepts.explanation: Helper warnings surface close-to-cap and low-balance states before a decline, prompting you to add funds or adjust the card cap.

quizzes.question: What does PayProxyProvider hold at its core?
choices: WalletBalance, a VirtualCard list with name/cap/end-date, and CardTransaction history with store/amount/date/result
Only a user profile and theme settings
Only a single card number and CVV
Only transaction history without wallet or cards
quizzes.explanation: The provider holds WalletBalance, the VirtualCard list with name, cap and end-date, and CardTransaction history with store, amount, date and result.

quizzes.question: How do you practice without moving real money?
choices: Enable test-mode which uses demoUser, demoBalance, demoCards, demoTransactions and shows testModeMessage
Delete your wallet and recreate it
Close all cards and open new ones
quizzes.explanation: Test-mode provides demoUser, demoBalance, demoCards, demoTransactions and a testModeMessage so no real money moves while you learn.

quizzes.question: What do freeze, unfreeze and close do?
choices: Freeze pauses spending on a card, unfreeze resumes it, close permanently shuts it down
They change the mint token colors
They only hide the card visually but still allow charges
They reset your WalletBalance to zero
quizzes.explanation: Freeze/unfreeze/close control the card lifecycle: pause, resume, or permanently end a virtual card, while warnings flag close-to-cap and low-balance risks.

accessibility.reducedMotion: RevealOnScroll respects reduced-motion preferences — animations are disabled or simplified when reduced motion is requested.
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard access for wallet, cards, and history controls with visible focus, logical tab order, and sticky AppShell navigation reachable without a mouse.
